title: Comparing DPO vs. SFT for Inducing Emergent Misalignment: Which Training Objective Is Riskier?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: DPO has largely replaced RLHF in practice. If DPO on misaligned preferences triggers emergent misalignment, the risk extends to the dominant training method. Directly extends the risk surface characterization. Immediate practical relevance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires constructing preference pairs (insecure preferred, secure rejected) for DPO, plus the standard SFT setup. Two training runs. TRL supports both. Constructing DPO preference data from the existing SFT dataset requires some thought but is feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two training runs (SFT and DPO), same evaluation. Clear deliverable: comparison of misalignment rates under two training objectives. Manageable scope within 30 hours if preference pair construction is straightforward.
